name: Community — Krea 2
author: Krea AI
description: Nine Krea 2 single-pass DiT checkpoints — Moody Mix, RedCraft Red Mix, Realia, Fascium, BF95 Dark Realism, Dark Beast (fp8), Muse v3.5 Extended, FinalCut v2 (matte skin) and Binyuan Portrait v3.2 (East Asian portraits). Uncensored/photoreal 8-10 step distilled checkpoints at CFG 1, rendering at native ~2 MP (1408x1408 and equivalents) with an Upscale slider (1.1-2x adds a 4-step detail-refine pass; 1x is a clean single pass), all sharing one Qwen3VL 4B encoder and Qwen-Image VAE, so each extra mix costs only its ~12-14 GB checkpoint. Four of the nine (RedCraft, Fascium, Dark Beast, FinalCut) are NSFW-capable.

presets.name: Moody Krea 2 Mix V1.0
presets.description: Uncensored Krea 2 diffusion-transformer mix tuned for moody, photoreal output. Best skin texture and natural anatomy of the Krea presets. 8-step distilled at CFG 1. Warm, freckled, natural skin; the reference look of the pack. Renders at native ~2 MP; the Upscale slider (1.1-2x) adds a 4-step detail-refine pass, verified clean at 1.5x.

requirements.notes: Krea-2 DiT (diffusion_models) + Qwen3VL 4B encoder + Qwen-Image VAE. euler/simple, CFG 1, negative zeroed. Uncensored mix. Renders at ~2 MP natively (Krea 2 supports 1K-2K); 2048x2048 also works on 12 GB but takes ~3x longer. Upscale >1 adds a lanczos resize plus a 4-step denoise-0.1 refine pass, as in the official Krea 2 Turbo preset; at Upscale 1 the refine is bypassed by a core ComfyMathExpression + ComfySwitchNode gate, because a same-size refine pass blotches skin on these mixes (tested 4 sampler/denoise variants, all bad; 1.5x is clean). Measured 2026-09-01: 1408x1408 in ~25 s on a 4070 Ti (~20 s at 1 MP); Upscale 1.5 to 2112x2112 adds ~10 s. 2048x2048 direct: ~70 s. All six presets were verified at Upscale 1 and 1.5 with the gate in place.

presets.name: Muse Krea 2 v3.5 Extended
presets.tagline: Clean editorial portraits with a real quality dial
presets.description: Stable Yogi's Muse v3.5 Extended — the most-downloaded Krea 2 checkpoint on Civitai, tuned for clean SFW editorial portraits, fashion and lifestyle characters. 'Extended' means it holds together across 8-20 steps and CFG 1-3 instead of being pinned to one turbo setting. Ships at 12 steps / CFG 1.5: natural pores and freckles without crunch. 8 steps CFG 1 is softer and 2x faster; the author's 16 steps / CFG 2 went over-baked and HDR-crunchy in our test, so treat CFG 2+ as a punch dial, not a default. Renders at native ~2 MP; the Upscale slider (1.1-2x) adds a 4-step detail-refine pass, verified clean at 1.5x.

requirements.notes: Krea-2 DiT (diffusion_models, fp8 scaled, 12.83 GB, SHA256 840EE6A7…) + Qwen3VL 4B encoder + Qwen-Image VAE. euler/simple, negative zeroed. SFW editorial mix. CFG above 1 runs a real negative pass, so per-step cost doubles. Measured 2026-09-01 on a 4070 Ti at 1408x1408: 8 st/CFG 1 ~24 s, 12 st/CFG 1.5 ~59 s, 16 st/CFG 2 ~78 s (all incl. model load); Upscale 1.5 to 2112x2112 adds ~30 s. Upscale >1 adds a lanczos resize plus a 4-step denoise-0.1 refine pass gated by ComfyMathExpression + ComfySwitchNode so Upscale 1 is a clean single pass. Author says do not exceed CFG 3.

presets.name: FinalCut Krea 2 v2 (INT8)
presets.tagline: Matte skin, no Krea gloss; native up to 2432x1920
presets.description: Felldude's FinalCut v2 — a trained Krea 2 finetune (hundreds of hours), not a merge, whose whole point is killing Krea 2's glossy 'wet skin'. In our side-by-side the claim holds: matte skin and cooler, softer light where Moody and Realia show forehead and cheek sheen. NSFW-capable, SFW fine. The author's native latent ceiling of 2432x1920 also holds: coherent in ~66 s on a 4070 Ti. INT8 ConvRot build, the author's recommended file. Renders at native ~2 MP; the Upscale slider (1.1-2x) adds a 4-step detail-refine pass, verified clean at 1.5x.

requirements.notes: Krea-2 DiT (diffusion_models, INT8 ConvRot, 14.47 GB, SHA256 7DFF8A1F…) + Qwen3VL 4B encoder + Qwen-Image VAE. euler/simple, CFG 1, negative zeroed. presets.name: Binyuan Krea 2 Portrait v3.2
presets.tagline: East Asian portrait realism, trained on unedited photos
presets.description: Binyuan's Krea 2 Portrait v3.2 — the official Turbo finetuned on ~1,000 unedited studio photographs of East Asian women. The only checkpoint in the pack aimed at East Asian faces, and in our studio test it gave the most photographic result of the three tried: natural features, matte skin, convincing hair, where Moody went waxy. It reads lighting words literally (a 'softbox' in the prompt got drawn into the frame), so describe light quality rather than gear. v3.2 is the author's stable release; v4.x are marked experimental by the author. SFW-oriented. Renders at native ~2 MP; the Upscale slider (1.1-2x) adds a 4-step detail-refine pass, verified clean at 1.5x.
